note: Path pieces, 32x16, anchor (16,8) = tile centre. seg_<dir> runs from the centre to the edge midpoint (NE/SE/SW/NW) or the corner (N/E/S/W, diagonal moves) toward that neighbour. Per path tile: seg toward the previous tile + seg toward the next; first tile: start + seg toward next; last tile: seg toward previous + head_<direction of travel>. Draw after range overlays, before units.
